coverage_note: Per-package statement coverage. money/ledger (the pure invariant core) are highest; store/api are additionally exercised by ops/settle/api tests and the live load harness, which per-package coverage does not credit.
code_review: A background go-reviewer flagged one CRITICAL settlement double-pay race (net computed before the merchant/payout row locks were held). Fixed: RunSettlement now locks all merchant+payout accounts FOR UPDATE and computes the net UNDER the locks; regression test TestConcurrentSettlementPaysExactlyOnce (16 concurrent settlement runs -> paid exactly once) added.
machine: Apple M5 Pro, 18 cores, 24 GB RAM, macOS 25.4.0 (Darwin), Go 1.26.3
